title: Enhancing Employability of Caregivers who Experienced Career Interruption
what_it_is: Enhancing Employability of Caregivers who Experienced Career Interruption

sections.label: Caregiver employability and support
sections.summary: Government supports caregivers returning to work through flexible work arrangements, tripartite guidelines, and Workforce Singapore employment programmes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether the Government will consider a study on enhancing the employability of caregivers through raising awareness among employers of the character traits and personal values demonstrated when an individual has interrupted his career in order to be a caregiver for their elderly or ailing parent.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We recognise positive traits, such as resilience and sense of duty, among this group of caregivers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, we are mindful not to overgeneralise caregivers as they are unique individuals after all, and employers ought to assess each of them fairly based on their qualities and ability to fulfil the job requirements without bias.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To support caregivers in returning to work, the Government and tripartite partners encourage the adoption of flexible work arrangements, or FWAs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We have developed resources, such as implementation guides and FWA policy templates, and conducted workshops to guide employers in adopting FWAs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will also be introducing a set of Tripartite Guidelines on FWAs by 2024, and this will set norms for FWA requests to be requested and evaluated fairly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In addition, Workforce Singapore provides employment facilitation programmes and services for caregivers who need support to return to the workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, Career Conversion Programmes provide training and salary support to employers who hire and reskill mid-career jobseekers for new occupations, with higher support for those who have not been in work for at least six months.

sections.label: Workplace fairness interim report
sections.summary: MOM and tripartite partners released an interim report on workplace fairness legislation protecting caregivers and other groups from discrimination.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Members may have observed that yesterday, MOM, together with our tripartite partners, released our interim report on workplace fairness legislation, which includes protecting caregivers and several groups against discrimination.
